sessionStart.command: node -e "const f=require('fs'),p=require('path'),o=require('os');const [n,s,r]=process.argv.slice(1);const ok=d=>{try{return JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(p.join(d,'plugin.json'),'utf8')).name===n&&f.existsSync(p.join(d,s))}catch(e){return false}};const ls=d=>{try{return f.readdirSync(d).map(x=>p.join(d,x))}catch(e){return []}};let root=r&&p.isAbsolute(r)&&ok(r)?r:null;if(!root){const h=o.homedir(),c=[];for(const b of [p.join(h,'Library','Application Support'),p.join(h,'.config'),process.env.APPDATA||h])for(const v of ['Code','Code - Insiders'])for(const x of ls(p.join(b,v,'agentPlugins')))c.push(...ls(x));for(const v of ['.vscode','.vscode-insiders'])for(const a of ls(p.join(h,v,'agent-plugins')))for(const b of ls(a))for(const x of ls(b))c.push(p.join(x,'plugins',n),p.join(x,n));for(const x of ls(p.join(process.env.COPILOT_HOME||p.join(h,'.copilot'),'installed-plugins')))c.push(p.join(x,n));root=c.filter(d=>p.isAbsolute(d)&&ok(d)).sort((a,b)=>f.statSync(p.join(b,'plugin.json')).mtimeMs-f.statSync(p.join(a,'plugin.json')).mtimeMs)[0];}if(root){const x=require('child_process').spawnSync(process.execPath,[p.join(root,s)],{stdio:'inherit',env:Object.assign({},process.env,{PLUGIN_ROOT:root})});process.exitCode=x.status||0}" docs-onboarding-buddy scripts/repo-map-context.mjs "${PLUGIN_ROOT}"
